name: Fungal Spores
summary: Apothecary Helbrim of the Royal Apothecary Society tasks Horde adventurers with gathering fungal spores around the oases of the Barrens. The strange, mutative energies coursing through these springs have altered the local flora into potent reagents. Helbrim seeks to harvest these unique specimens to brew concoctions for his colleague in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Vibrant and Mutated Flora
sections.body: The Barrens is generally an arid, sun-scorched savanna, yet its oases—such as the Forgotten Pools, the Lushwater Oasis, and the Stagnant Oasis—burst with unnatural vitality. A curious surge of life energy flows from these waters, warping and invigorating the plants and beasts that drink from them. Laden mushrooms growing along the muddy banks absorb these intense currents, filling their spores with rare properties that pique the curiosity of passing alchemists.

sections.title: The Royal Apothecary Society in Kalimdor
sections.body: Though stationed far from the Undercity at the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim remains devoted to the research of the Royal Apothecary Society. Recognizing the strange potency of Kalimdor's native reagents, he collects these altered spores to craft powerful mixtures. The specimens gathered here are destined for Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, demonstrating the subtle, far-reaching scientific efforts the Forsaken carry out across allied lands.

faq.q: Where do these fungal spores grow?
faq.answer: The spores are gathered from laden mushrooms growing along the water's edge at the oases in the Barrens, including the Forgotten Pools, the Lushwater Oasis, and the Stagnant Oasis.

faq.q: Why are the mushrooms altered near the oases?
aliases: what is wrong with the oases
faq.answer: A powerful surge of life energy flows through the oasis waters in the Barrens. Rather than sustaining normal plant growth, this energy aggressively invigorates and alters the surrounding wildlife and flora.

Apothecary Helbrim is a member of the Forsaken's Royal Apothecary Society stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He studies the region's unusual biology and harvests local materials for alchemical study.

faq.q: What does Helbrim plan to do with the spores?
faq.answer: Helbrim uses the potent spores to formulate a specific concoction, which he intends to send to his research associate, Apothecary Zamah, in the tauren city of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why are Forsaken apothecaries operating in the Barrens?
faq.answer: As part of the Horde alliance, Forsaken researchers study foreign environments and unique flora across Kalimdor to discover new reagents for medicines, toxins, and concoctions.

faq.q: Which oasis is safest to collect the spores from?
faq.answer: The Forgotten Pools, located northwest of the Crossroads, is populated by lower-level wildlife compared to the Lushwater Oasis or the Stagnant Oasis to the south, making it the safest spot to gather the mushrooms.

angles.text: Even far from Lordaeron, Forsaken researchers continue their alchemical work, turning Kalimdor's natural anomalies toward the goals of the Royal Apothecary Society.
Investigating the disturbed waters of the Barrens helps protect the vital trails connecting Orgrimmar, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff.
The oases harbor an unnaturally turbulent surge of nature magic that causes aggressive mutations in the surrounding ecosystem.
The laden mushrooms growing around the Barrens oases showcase how sudden infusions of environmental energy can transform ordinary flora into potent reagents.
